subject: [PATCH 1/2] crypto: zstd - Avoid redundant cstream initialization

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the initialization of a shared workspace in the zstd compression algorithm by deferring it until the first iteration that needs it. This avoids redundant initialization, which can be expensive due to CPUID instructions and layout changes. The patch introduces a flag to track whether the CStream has been initialized, and only initializes it when necessary. This results in a small but measurable performance improvement of 2.4% on a bare-metal host and 9.8% in a KVM guest.
